value.rationale: At the original study’s collective transition, a physically meaningful first-opposite-reset time crosses from an exponentially large lifetime with a computable nonquadratic large-deviation exponent to a universal quarter-power law. The coefficient incorporates every coherent half-period weighted by reset ages, and the distributional limit distinguishes typical and mean switching times.
